column1: Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14

B
Y virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 10, 15, 109, 118 and 129
of Block 03, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 830137, situated in the Village of Beliatta Town within the Grama Niladhari Division
of No. 351 - Beliatta Town in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Beliatta, in the District of Hambantota, in the Province of Southern,
referred to in Notice No. 83/0285 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2090/31 of 27th Sep-
tember, 2018 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
